audited_source_corrections.action: Removed the extra Gamma argument from the satisfaction expression for A_n.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The assumption case writes the satisfaction macro with three braced arguments although every semantic clause takes the model and formula, followed by the world argument.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் நிறுவல் $!A_n$ ஐ $w$ இல் நேரடியாக நிறைவுசெய்யும் இரு-வாத மெய்ப்பாட்டு வடிவத்தைப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Treating Gamma as an undocumented middle macro argument, inconsistent with every other occurrence in the chapter.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: From A_n in Gamma and satisfaction of Gamma at w, the needed conclusion is satisfaction of A_n at w.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the assumption case conclude satisfaction of A_n at w with the standard macro arity?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the required conclusion from A and B to the actual premise formulas B and C.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The case has derivations of B and C but asks for consequence A and B, while its last sentence correctly establishes B and C.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் முடிவு முன்னுரைகளுடன் ஒத்த $!B\land !C$ என்று தருகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Renaming every premise and the final satisfaction claims to A and B.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Conjunction introduction combines exactly the two derived premise formulas.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the semantic goal of conjunction introduction use B and C throughout?

audited_source_corrections.action: Made the right-introduction branch conclude B or C rather than merely restating C.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: After proving the left-introduction branch, the parallel right branch states only that Gamma entails C and omits the rule's disjunctive conclusion.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இரண்டாம் கிளையும் $\Gamma\Entails !B\lor !C$ என்ற அதே முடிவை அடைகிறது என்று கூறுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Leaving the rule application implicit after the premise consequence.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Soundness of right disjunction introduction must establish the conclusion of the displayed rule.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the C-premise branch explicitly conclude the disjunction?

audited_source_corrections.action: Moved the world argument inside the satisfaction expression.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The first semantic case closes math mode before [w], unlike the parallel C case and every satisfaction expression around it.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Leaving [w] as visually adjacent prose, which breaks the formal expression.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The case assumes B is true at the current world w.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is the world argument part of the B-satisfaction formula?

audited_source_corrections.action: Restored singleton-set braces around B and C in the two semantic consequence premises.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The derivation premises correctly use Delta_i union singleton sets, but the semantic application later unions a set directly with a formula.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இரு இடங்களிலும் $\{!B\}$, $\{!C\}$ என்ற ஒருறுப்புக் கணங்களைப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Treating formulas as sets or changing the earlier derivation premises.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Semantic entailment takes a set of assumptions, so the discharged case assumption must be adjoined as a singleton set.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Do both case consequences adjoin singleton assumption sets?
